title: Ask Me Anything with Roger Dingledine: Tor, Privacy and 20+ Years of Open Source
description:
Roger Dingledine co-founded the Tor Project and has spent more than two decades building and maintaining one of the world's most important pieces of open source privacy software. Millions of people use it every day, from journalists and human rights defenders to anyone who wants to browse without being tracked.

In this open session, you set the agenda. Bring your questions about:

- how Tor works and where it's heading

- what it takes to keep critical open source infrastructure alive for decades

- funding and sustaining a nonprofit open source project

- privacy and anonymity in a world of AI and surveillance

- what the Web3 and open source communities can learn from each other about decentralization
